findings.claim: Round 0's fixture-parity finding was fixed only for the two specs it named: chat-send-history-race.spec.ts registers its own conversation-detail GET mock (after mockAuthenticatedApi, so Playwright LIFO makes it win) that returns `{id, title, selectedModels, disabledPanels, messages: [], nextCursor: null}` with no `messagePage`, so the new first-page validation throws, releaseChatRuntimeLoad marks the key failed, and — because the panel's auto-send effect now returns while `!runtime.isLoaded` — the first send of the newly created qa-conversation is never dispatched at all; the file is outside `writableScope`, so the change as scoped leaves the suite red.
findings.reproduction: npm run test:e2e:run -- --project=desktop-chromium tests/e2e/chat-send-history-race.spec.ts  — expected 2 passed. Actual (per the code paths above): both tests fail at `expect(userMessages(page, "survives the late history load")).toHaveCount(1)`; the panel shows `[data-testid="chat-history-load-error"]` instead of the transcript and no POST /api/chat is made, because the fixture create returns id `qa-conversation` (tests/e2e/support/app-fixtures.ts:710,1022), the panel claims a load for that key (components/chat/ChatApp.tsx:806, lib/chatStreamRuntime.ts:392-399 now clears isLoaded), the spec's mock answers after 1500ms without `messagePage`, and the promptPayload effect is gated on `runtime.isLoaded`. Same class of check for any other spec that overrides the detail GET: only chat-markdown-theme, conversation-draft-isolation and app-fixtures were updated.

findings.claim: The new `chat.savedQuestionNotSent` toast is not gated on the identity still being current, so when the model-only Message POST is outstanding across an account switch the record is deleted by releaseChatRuntimeForOtherIdentities (ChatPageClient.tsx:1953), the generation lookup fails, and the previous identity's failure is announced on the new identity's screen — contrary to criterion 3, and inconsistent with the adjacent `sendPreparationChanged` toast, which is shown only when `identityKey === currentIdentityKey` (ChatPageClient.tsx:4752-4754).
findings.reproduction: In tests/e2e/chat-unified-workspace.spec.ts, openChat({legacyReview: true, selectedModels: [MODEL_A, MODEL_B], holdMessageSaveBeforeTransaction: true}); fill and submit model-only; after `state.messageSaveStarted()`, switch identity (the account-B path already in this fixture, `hidePreviousAccount`/accountBConversations); then `state.releaseMessageSave()`. Expected: no toast for the released identity's key. Actual: the app toast "Your question was saved, but no answer request was sent." appears on the new identity's workspace.

findings.reproduction: On the canonical (Linux) runner: npm run test:e2e:run -- --project=desktop-chromium --project=mobile-chromium tests/e2e/chat-state-visual-regression.spec.ts --grep "Loading state" and npm run test:e2e:run -- --project=mobile-chromium tests/e2e/chat-unified-workspace.spec.ts tests/e2e/model-change-send-barrier.spec.ts. Expected: goldens compared and passing with `updateSnapshots: "none"`. verdict.nextAction: Bring tests/e2e/chat-send-history-race.spec.ts's conversation-detail mock to the real API's required messagePage shape (extending writableScope for that file) and re-run it plus the mobile/golden regressions; round 0's findings 3 and 4 are addressed (toasts now fire only on loadFailed, and the saved-but-undispatched disposition exists in all seven locales).
